summary_en: 110,800 shares acquired for ¥242.3M (1.59% of shares outstanding) via ToSTNeT-3 in May 2026. Authorized limit: 200,000 shares (2.86% S/O) / ¥500M through March 2027. Acquisition period: 1 May – 31 May 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Market Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
Yoshicon Co., Ltd. announced on 1 June 2026 that it completed a market acquisition of 110,800 of its own shares during the period 1 May – 31 May 2026 for an aggregate of ¥242,324,700. The shares were acquired via open-market purchase including ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange) transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The acquisition was conducted under a board resolution dated 30 April 2026, which authorized the company to acquire up to 200,000 shares (2.86% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury stock) for an aggregate amount not to exceed ¥500,000,000 during the period 1 May 2026 through 31 March 2027. As of 31 May 2026, cumulative acquisitions totalled 110,800 shares for ¥242,324,700, consuming approximately 55% of the authorized share limit and 49% of the yen limit.
